summary.text: Backend engineer with 8 years building payment and logistics systems in Python and Go. Led the migration of a monolith to event-driven services handling 40M events a day, and cut infrastructure spend by 31% through capacity work on Kubernetes.

bullets.text: Led a team of 5 migrating shipment tracking from a Django monolith to Go services on Kafka, raising throughput to 40M events/day with p99 latency under 120 ms.
Cut monthly AWS spend by 31% ($84K/year) by right-sizing EKS node pools and moving batch jobs to spot instances.
Designed an idempotent webhook delivery system with retry queues, reducing customer-reported missed notifications from about 200 a week to under 5.
Introduced contract testing with Pact across 14 services, catching 22 breaking API changes before release in one quarter.
Built the ledger reconciliation service in Python and PostgreSQL that matched $2.1B in annual card transactions against bank settlement files.
Cut reconciliation runtime from 6 hours to 35 minutes by partitioning tables and parallelizing with Celery.
Owned PCI DSS evidence collection for the payments platform across two annual audits with zero findings.
Shipped inventory sync between Shopify and three warehouse systems, used by 1,200 merchants.
Added structured logging and Datadog dashboards that cut median incident triage time from 50 to 15 minutes.
Open-source Postgres-backed job queue for Go using SKIP LOCKED; 900 GitHub stars and used in production by several startups.
